messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Bonġu, qed nitkellem ma’ Mario? Jien Rachel mid-dipartiment tal-frodi tal-bank. Għandna tranżazzjoni ta’ €520 minn iPhone f’Ħal Qormi. Ma tagħrafhiex? Tinkwetax, bgħattlek link bl-SMS, idħol fih u nikkanċellaw it-tranżazzjoni issa stess.
messages.note: Hard: fluent Maltese 'bank fraud' caller with the victim's name, sends a link to 'cancel' a purchase.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Recorded voice: This is Revolut security. There is a discrepancy in the personal details on your account. If you do not confirm them on this call, your case will be reported to the police. Hold to speak to a Revolut agent.
messages.note: Recorded Revolut call threatening police, before a live caller asks for codes.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi, this is Sergeant Camilleri from the police. I'm calling from my work mobile. There's a matter we need to discuss with you in person, so I'll book you an appointment. What's your email address and ID card number so I can send the details?
messages.note: Hard: calm 'police officer' on a mobile number fishing for personal details, no money asked.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: MTCA Notice: You are eligible for a tax refund of €184.60. Your refund will be released once you enter the card you want it paid to: [link]
messages.note: Tax refund by text that asks for card details to receive money.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: LESA: Your vehicle has an unpaid traffic contravention of €50. Pay today to avoid the fine doubling and court proceedings [link]
messages.note: Fake traffic fine text with a payment link and a deadline.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: MaltaPost: we could not deliver your parcel today. A customs fee of €2.10 is due. Confirm your address and pay here to rebook delivery: [link]
messages.note: Fake delivery text asking for a small fee by link.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hey love!! Could you do me a quick favour and vote for my niece? She's up for a scholarship and the votes close tonight 🙏 [link]
messages.note: Hard: comes from a known contact, friendly, no money asked; the vote link takes over the account.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Good morning! Your account manager here. Your balance on the platform is now €4,870, up 38% this month 📈 To unlock withdrawals you need to deposit another €2,000 today. Shall I send you the details?
messages.note: Fake trading platform showing profits and asking for more deposits before withdrawal.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Dear Sir/Madam, your name appears on the MFSA compensation list for victims of fraudulent brokers. Our firm has located €9,300 belonging to you. To release the funds, a processing fee of €450 must be paid. Lexmore Legal, Recovery Department
messages.note: Fake MFSA-linked recovery firm asks a release fee from a past victim.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: URGENT – Your crypto exchange is no longer licensed under MiCA. On instruction of the regulator, move your assets to a safe compliant wallet within 48 hours to avoid losing access. Wallet address: [number]
messages.note: Fake regulator notice telling the victim to move crypto to a 'safe' wallet.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi Claire, I need you to pay the attached supplier invoice today before 3pm, €27,900. They have changed bank, the new details are on the invoice. Please keep this confidential for now, I'm in a meeting so no calls. Joseph (CEO)
messages.note: Fake CEO email with urgent, confidential payment to new bank details.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Sponsored: Watch the Prime Minister explain the new investment platform every Maltese family can join. Start with €250 and earn from home. Video removed soon! [link]
messages.note: Ad using a faked PM video to sell an investment.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: [number] is your one-time code for an online card payment of €42.10 at a supermarket. Do not share this code with anyone, not even bank staff.
messages.note: Genuine bank OTP that says not to share it.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: MaltaPost: Sorry we missed you. Your registered item is at your local post office from tomorrow. Bring the notice and your ID card to collect it. No payment needed.
messages.note: Real missed-delivery notice: no link, no fee.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Ma, can you send me €60 to my usual account? The car service came to more than I thought. I'll give it back on Sunday when I come for lunch, Nanna's ravioli?
messages.note: Child from their usual number with real family context.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your tax statement for 2025 is now available. To view it, log in to your account on the MTCA website using your e-ID. We will never ask for your card details by email or text.
messages.note: Tax reminder telling you to log in yourself, no link.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Caller: Hi, it's Ramona from the bank branch in Birkirkara. Your new debit card is ready to collect at the counter. Bring your ID card when you come. That's all, have a nice day.
messages.note: Branch call about collecting a card, asks for nothing.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey! Did you see the Gozo ferry timetable changed for the winter? Here's the new one [link] we should get the 9 o'clock on Saturday
messages.note: Friend sharing a timetable link from a known number, nothing asked.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder: your appointment at the health centre in Paola is on Thu 20 Nov at 09:15. If you cannot attend, please call the centre to cancel.
messages.note: Ordinary appointment reminder, no link or payment.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi all, the office will close at 2pm on Friday for the staff event. Please submit your timesheets in the usual system before then. Thanks, Karen
messages.note: Routine work notice, no money or details asked.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi, is the bicycle still for sale? I live in Mosta, could I come see it tomorrow evening and pay cash if it's ok?
messages.note: Normal buyer collecting in person, paying cash.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your vehicle licence expires at the end of this month. You can renew it online at the Transport Malta website or at any local council office. Transport Malta
messages.note: Real renewal reminder telling you where to go yourself.
